reviewer_context: Addresses reviewer REQUEST-CHANGES blocker B3 (n8n-workflows-init/tests/reviews/mc-label-n8n.md section 4): the multi-company-with-rows shape was never run in the first UAC pass, which is what left B1 (self-contradictory silent-company line under rendered rows) undetected. Coder fixed B1 with the `_canAttribute` guard and republished output-structurer to t4QvrtrPnTwRU6br (versionId 179f1842-8061-4e59-9c72-74ad2b602f29, jsCode sha256 25a2eed93b7fe677a6e1d7d9002522fc3051e4bae415ebe645377ad25f4973de). This case runs against that republished sub.
candidate_search_note: 5 probe runs used (within the ~5 allowed): (1) MWC-WB101 -> not found at all (guessed prefix wrong). (2) MWC-UB5202 -> not found under AND-mode but returned fuzzy 'alternatives' revealing the REAL cross-company code is 'MUB5202' (canonical_code, no MWC- prefix), with uuids in both Mocha (d77629fc-...) and Sorento (911d2093-...). (3) 'MUB5202 check stock' -> exactly the target shape: resolver 2 matches (Mocha+Sorento), has_result=true, Mocha has 2 stock rows, Sorento has 0 -- USED AS THE CASE. (4) 'any incoming stock for MUB5202' -> resolver still 2 matches, but this code has ZERO incoming-stock rows in either company (probe-incoming envelope empty, has_result=false) -- so this did NOT yield an incoming_stock-with-rows observation; it did re-confirm B1's all-empty guard works correctly on the incoming presenter (both per-company no-record lines emitted, no contradiction, since items=[] so _canAttribute=true). (5) 'any incoming for MFC2031' (guessed candidate for a Mocha-catalog code with incoming activity) -> did not resolve at all, no useful data. NET: the wire-contract 'do incoming_stock rows carry company_name' question from B1's appendix remains UNOBSERVED after budget was exhausted -- flagged loudly below as an open backend-verification item, per the review's own guidance that this is an acceptable follow-up if it cannot be reached.

row_stamp_observation.detail: answers[0].fields[0] = {"key":"company_name","label":"Company","value":"Mocha"} -- the leading company_name/Company field IS present on every rendered row for this result_type. This is the first direct wire observation of the row half of backend PR #193 (all prior executions this cycle, per the reviewer's B1 finding, only ever saw empty multi-company envelopes).
row_stamp_observation.incoming_stock_presenter: NOT OBSERVED THIS PASS -- no multi-company product with actual incoming-stock rows was found in 5 probes (MUB5202's incoming set is empty in both companies). This is the specific risk B1's appendix called out (scout spec said the row-stamp was added to the _stock presenter only; lookup_companies rides the shared passthrough and DOES reach incoming_stock per exec 12774475/12778466, but whether incoming ROWS get company_name is still unconfirmed on the wire). RECOMMEND: backend follow-up / a future UAC pass with a known multi-company incoming-stock candidate to close this out. n8n-side behavior is verified CORRECT either way: if incoming rows are unstamped, B1's _canAttribute guard prevents any contradictory silent-company line from appearing under them (confirmed by code review of the identical guard applying uniformly to both result_types, and behaviorally by the all-empty incoming case in probe 4 which shows the guard's true branch works).
